title: Denoise stack (DeepInterpolation)
description: Removes independent noise with DeepInterpolation (Lecoq et al. 2021), as dev's Denoiser does, when the deepinterpolation package and h5py are installed: each frame is predicted from the frames around it by a trained network, given as modelPath (an .h5 model, such as the Allen Institute's pretrained two-photon models). Frames too close to the start or end to be predicted are kept as they were.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: Denoised stack
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

omittedFrames.title: Frames left out next to the predicted one
